Pre-flight award counts for a set of UEIs

Source: R/api-search.R
us_award_counts.Rd

Cheap reconnaissance before committing to a pull: how many prime awards each UEI has, by category. Use it to decide between the API and the archive path, to size download batches, and to distinguish genuine non-recipients from failed requests.

Usage

us_award_counts(uei, start_date = "2007-10-01", end_date = Sys.Date())

Arguments

uei

Character vector of UEIs.

start_date, end_date

Action-date bounds.

Value

A data.table: one row per UEI with contracts, idvs, grants, direct_payments, loans, other, n_awards, error, message.

Details

Failures are recorded, never swallowed. A request that errors comes back with error = TRUE and n_awards = NA, because a failure that reads as zero is the most damaging silent bug in this pipeline – it turns a rate-limit blip into a permanent "this nonprofit gets no federal money".

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
us_award_counts(c("CFFMYPABYAG3", "H7LMD1ANJNN4"))
} # }
